provider.name: QAF-035 QA/beta provider
provider.accountScope: QA/beta Xtream provider account used for the 300-500 live-user beta. Credentials are intentionally not recorded in this artifact.
provider.notes: Partial provider owner signoff only. Final beta readiness still needs a named provider/XUI owner, contact path, account scope confirmation, capacity evidence, and explicit no-transcode/no-remux commitment.

target.trafficModel: Live TV beta cohort with normal channel zapping and catch-up attempts kept on provider media bytes.

forbiddenResolutionPaths: Do not resolve broken catch-up channels with local ffmpeg or ffprobe.
Do not resolve broken catch-up channels with server-side media processing, transcode, remux, generated HLS, proxy-remuxed, or remux-hls.
Do not resolve broken catch-up channels with XUI-side media processing, XUI-side transcode, or XUI-side remux.
mediaProcessingCommitment.notes: Partial no-media-processing commitment only. Final beta readiness still needs provider/XUI owner evidence that no XUI-side transcode, XUI-side remux, generated HLS, server-side media processing, or local ffmpeg/ffprobe workaround will be used.

capacityCommitment.notes: Partial capacity commitment only. Final beta readiness still needs provider/XUI approval for 300-500 concurrent live users, account limits, rate-limit policy, and escalation contact.

checks.description: Provider/XUI owner identity, role, contact, and account scope are recorded.
Provider/XUI owner confirms the beta account and upstream service can support 300-500 concurrent live users.
Provider/XUI owner confirms no XUI-side transcode/remux/media-processing workaround will be enabled for broken catch-up channels.
Provider/XUI owner confirms broken catch-up channels will not be resolved with generated HLS, proxy-remuxed, remux-hls, local ffmpeg, or server-side media processing.
Provider escalation and rollback/throttle contact is recorded for auth, 429/5xx, and capacity incidents during beta.

signoff.notes: Partial provider owner signoff only. This artifact must fail --require-final until provider/XUI owner, account capacity, rate-limit policy, escalation path, no-transcode/no-remux commitment, and final approval are recorded.
